description: Application to clear condition 6 (SuDS) of approved application DM2024/01560.
decision_conditions: Prior to the commencement of development, a finalised SuDS strategy for the management of surface water run-off must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which includes:(i) details of proposed SuDS measures in order to manage surface water run off as close to its source as possible in accordance with the Mayor's drainage (ii) the outcome of infiltration testing to BRE Digest 365 and ground investigations to investigate the feasibility or otherwise of infiltration SuDS techniques;(iii) further details of proposed source control SuDS measures, including the proposed blue/green roof;(iv) include revised calculations carried out by an appropriately qualified professional to show that the peak run-off rate for the 1 in 100 year 6-hour rainfall event (plus40% for climate change) will be as close as reasonably practicable to the greenfield run-off rate for the same event; and(v) demonstrate that the 1 in 30 year rainfall event (plus 40% for climate change) can be contained without flooding; any flooding occurring between the 1 in 30 and 1 in 100 year event (plus 40% for climate change) will be safely contained on site; and that rainfall in excess of the 1 in 100 year event is managed to minimise risksReason: To comply with London Plan Policy SI13 and Policy 32 of the Local Plan 2018.
